title: Salvation Army of Laredo Serves Thanksgiving Meals to More Than 100 People
excerpt: The Salvation Army of Laredo provided Thanksgiving turkey meals to more than 100 people during its annual Thanksgiving event this week, and attendees also received jackets and small blankets.
content:
The Salvation Army of Laredo provided Thanksgiving turkey meals to more than 100 people during its annual Thanksgiving event this week, according to KGNS.

Many of the people who came for a meal return year after year to receive the organization’s social services, KGNS reported.

Attendees also received jackets and small blankets along with their meals.

The Thanksgiving meal is one of the Salvation Army’s annual traditions in Laredo, serving neighbors who count on the organization through the year.

Sources: KGNS, Nov. 27, 2026.
